research(ml-strategy-tournament-v1): H126/H252 tournament results, winner anatomy, overfit diagnostics, data audit, independent NAV, Korean report

148 strategies (141 ML + 7 rules), 1,692 H126 + 504 H252 walk-forward fits on the PIT Top120.
Top CAGR is RULE_INDUSTRY_MOMENTUM (23.27% vs 17.97% ETF); best ML is XGB_CI_RANK_h1 (forced top-5,
19.36%). 0/141 ML configs beat the ETF under the frozen gated rule. Exploratory, outcome-exposed;
no production, sealed spec, lock or signal-history change.
